integrity: Analytic proof includes exact Haar moments, positive variance recursion, secular Perron root, strict convexity and equality classification. Standard-library checker confirms 2171 finite cases; finite tests do not establish general results. Publication priority is subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary SPD quadratic with independent real Haar subspaces, unbiased symmetric two-point oracle and strict mean-square norm stability; sharp extremizers require prescribed minimum, maximum and trace. No finite-precision, nonquadratic, noisy objective or almost-sure boundary assertion. Older equivalent priorities not excluded.
title: Sharp trace-conditioned stability envelopes for orthogonal-subspace zeroth-order descent
